checkpoint: From the rival's battle up the Tower to 5F (PokemonTower_3F.._5F map.json, scripts.inc): every floor tile from 3F up has wild Pokemon, so first a Super Repel. The Channelers' lines (pret sight): 3F Patricia (10, 14) and Carly (9, 9) south 3, Hope (12, 4) north and south 2; 4F Laurel (17, 7) south 3, Jody (15, 13) west 5, Paula (4, 12) east 2; 5F Ruth (11, 4) looks around 2, Tammy (19, 7) west 3, Karina (7, 12) east 2, Janae (11, 16) looks around 2.

3F and 4F are walked round every line. On 5F every way from the west stairs to the east stairs crosses Ruth's or Tammy's lines and row 6 crosses both: PokeGuy fought only Tammy, Ruth looking away. Here Ruth is waited for (trainer_wait) and fought, then Tammy. 5F's purified zone (10..12, 8..10) heals the party (PokemonTower_5F_EventScript_PurifiedZone); PokeGuy walks round it, and so does this.

The runtime maps (PokemonSimulation bdca47c) have no item balls on 5F and 6F, where pret has a NUGGET (6, 16) and the CLEANSE TAG (11, 9) on 5F, and the Rare Candy (5, 15) and an X ACCURACY (15, 15) on 6F: no way here steps on them.
